comment: Wave-3 compositional GUI layout for Nave (rollout-2026-07 + DECISIONS.md D1). Coordinates are plate-render pixels on the 1264x848 wave-2 empty family plate (plate_nave.png). Anchor semantics: knob = brass cap centre, slot = cartridge sprite canvas centre (see src/PluginEditorLayout.h). Census per control-inventory.md: 6 knobs (4+2 rows: tone+character bay over the output bay), 0 toggles (no host-visible bypass param), 0 meters (no metering DSP - no dead decoration), and the two D1 IR cartridge slots side by side between the ornamental top band and the knob field, wired to the REAL IR A/B loaders (gui/IrCartridgeSlot.h documents the operability contract).
